testFullDirectVerificationExceedsTheBloc.details: This test passes to *pin the limitation*, not to bless it. If the      verifier is ever made viable, this test fails and whoever fixed it      must update `FR-THRESH-4`'s recoverability claim with it. The      consequence is recorded in `STARK_AIR_GAP_ANALYSIS.md` §25.

testFixtureMatchesTheExpectedSizes().notice: The fixture must be the parameter set the contract expects,         so a rejection cannot be blamed on a size mismatch.

testFullDirectVerificationExceedsTheBloc.notice: Full-direct verification of a real signature cannot be executed         on-chain: it burns ~674M gas — more than twenty blocks' worth —         and reverts without completing.
